operations.name: hg_profile
operations.description: Return exact finite vertex and directed-hyperedge counts plus declared roots.

operations.name: hg_vertices
operations.description: Return the canonical lexical vertex list without inventing nodes.

operations.name: hg_hyperedges
operations.description: Return canonical directed hyperedges with sorted tails and heads.

operations.name: hg_incidence
operations.description: Return exact incoming and outgoing hyperedge identifiers for each vertex.

operations.name: hg_unique
operations.description: Confirm vertex, edge-identifier and canonical-edge uniqueness.

operations.name: hg_sources
operations.description: Return vertices with no incoming directed hyperedge.

operations.name: hg_sinks
operations.description: Return vertices with no outgoing directed hyperedge.

operations.name: hg_reachable
operations.description: Apply declared all-tail firing reachability from the synthetic roots.

operations.name: hg_layers
operations.description: Return the earliest all-tail firing layer for every reachable vertex.

operations.name: hg_transpose
operations.description: Swap every finite synthetic hyperedge tail and head.

operations.name: hg_union
operations.description: Return the canonical set union of two edge-signature collections.

operations.name: hg_intersection
operations.description: Return the canonical edge-signature intersection.

operations.name: hg_difference
operations.description: Return edge signatures present only in the first graph.

operations.name: hg_boundary
operations.description: Return tail-only, head-only and mixed-incidence synthetic vertices.

operations.name: hg_projection
operations.description: Project each directed hyperedge to its finite tail-to-head arc pairs.

operations.name: hg_components
operations.description: Return weak components of the finite incidence projection.

operations.name: hg_cut_candidates
operations.description: Return vertices whose removal increases weak-component count.

operations.name: hg_scene
operations.description: Represent one bounded accessible two-dimensional layout without physical meaning.

operations.name: hg_evidence_gap
operations.description: Retain missing empirical and independent evidence as an open gap.

operations.name: hg_authority_gate
operations.description: Retain legal, cultural, affected-party and Maori authority as exact gates.

semantics.directed_hyperedge: Each edge has one or more tail vertices and one or more head vertices.
semantics.reachability: All-tail firing: an edge fires only after every tail is reachable.
semantics.weak_component: Connected component after forgetting direction within each hyperedge incidence clique.
semantics.cut_candidate: A vertex whose omission increases the weak-component count of this finite graph.

ambiguity_limits: These conventions are declared model semantics, not unique universal hypergraph definitions.
Reachability and cuts do not establish physical pathways, causation or safety.
